title: helianthemum cinereum var. rubellum
intro: Helianthemum cinereum var. rubellum, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a flowering plant in the Cistaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating skin conditions such as eczema and acne due to its antibacterial and anti-inflammatory properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of soothing and calming the skin. The bioactive constituents of Helianthemum cinereum var. rubellum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. Additionally, the plant's antiseptic properties make it useful in treating minor cuts and scrapes, further highlighting its value in natural remedies.
